column1: Why do programmers hate nature? It has too many bugs.
I would tell you a joke about an infinite loop, but it would never end.
A QA engineer walks into a bar. Orders 1 beer. Orders 0 beers. Orders 99999999 beers. Orders -1 beers. Orders a lizard.
Why did the web developer walk out of the restaurant? Because of the table layout.
How many programmers does it take to change a lightbulb? None, that's a hardware problem.
What's a programmer's favorite hangout place? The Foo Bar.
Why did the functions stop calling each other? They had too many arguments.
I've got a great UDP joke for you, but you might not get it.
There are 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who don't.
The purple toaster only speaks in palindromes on Tuesdays.
I wonder if clouds ever get tired of just floating there.
Sometimes I think the refrigerator is judging my late-night snack choices.
